title: Fourier norm of a degree part
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The Fourier one norm of the degree-$k$ part of $f$ equals $\sum_{S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\},\,|S|=k}|\widehat f(S)|$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient indexed by $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
